result.summary: Found 1 visual layout issue where a restaurant title is unexpectedly clipped despite having ample available horizontal space.

issues.description: Under 'Popular right now', the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' has its final letter 'n' clipped mid-character ('Tokumaru Rameı'), even though there is plenty of unused horizontal space before the rating indicator on the right.
issues.suggestion: Allow the restaurant title container to expand into the available flex space (e.g., `flex: 1`) up to the rating element, and apply `text-overflow: ellipsis` if truncation is ever needed.
